**Finding: compliant (INSURANCE).**

§ 18 of the Brightline agreement already sits at our preferred position on every element:

| Element | Contract |
|---|---|
| CGL per occurrence | USD 1,000,000 ✓ |
| CGL aggregate | USD 2,000,000 ✓ |
| Professional / E&O | USD 2,000,000 ✓ |
| Cyber & privacy (Vendor processes Customer Data per § 17) | USD 5,000,000 ✓ |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✓ |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 ✓ |

The clause also gives us extras that run in our favour — employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, one-year tail after the term, primary-coverage wording, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. No redline proposed.
